roles.dp: net on anchor pin named D+/DP (USB-C: A6 and B6)
roles.dm: net on anchor pin named D-/DM (USB-C: A7 and B7)
roles.esd: part with >= 2 pins on {dp, dm} and one on GND
roles.cmc: 4-pin part in series on dp and dm
roles.transceiver: IC whose pins named D+/D-/USB_DP/USB_DM end dp/dm

rules.rule: D+/D- are a 90 ohm differential pair (45 ohm single-ended)
rules.note: SLLA414 states +/-15 %; SPRAAR7J tables +/-10 %. Needs a stackup (doc 15 §5.3). FS-only links tolerate much more; HS is the reason for the rule.

rules.rule: Route D+/D- coupled; intra-pair length mismatch <= 1.27 mm
rules.note: TI 50 mil; Raspberry Pi CM5 asks 0.15 mm. Default is TI's value.

rules.rule: Transceiver-to-connector length <= 203 mm recommended (hard ceiling 305 mm)
<= 4 vias per line, equal count on D+ and D-
No stubs or test points on D+/D- (inline and symmetric if unavoidable)
Keep 0.76 mm from other signals and 1.27 mm from clocks
ESD and common-mode choke as close to the connector as possible, flow-through
rules.note: 5 mm is TraceMaker's default for 'as close as possible'; sources give no number.

rules.rule: Along each line: connector -> ESD -> CMC -> transceiver
Route over solid GND on the adjacent layer; never cross a plane split
No AC coupling capacitors on D+/D-; P/N swap only if the PHY supports it
Receptacle at the board edge, mating face at or just past the edge
rules.note: General connector practice (CONN-01); kept here so the USB report is self-contained.

categories.name: USB 3.x SuperSpeed and USB Type-C receptacle

roles.dp_tie: D+ (A6, B6) and D- (A7, B7) joins on the receptacle
roles.esd: TVS parts on any connector signal

rules.rule: SuperSpeed pairs 90 ohm differential
rules.note: Tolerance varies: +/-7 % (SPRAAR7J), +/-10 % (TUSB8041), +/-15 % (SLLA414); some SoCs ask 95 ohm +/-5 %.

rules.rule: Intra-pair mismatch <= 0.127 mm; TX and RX need not be matched to each other
Each stub of the A6/B6 and A7/B7 D+/D- tie <= 3.5 mm
<= 2 vias per SuperSpeed line
SuperSpeed length <= 140 mm (SoC tables 89-140 mm; 203 mm absolute for hubs/PHYs)
TX AC caps (100 nF, 0402 or smaller, no arrays) symmetric near the connector, order connector -> ESD -> CMC -> caps
rules.note: Spec range 75-265 nF (recalled, not re-read).

rules.rule: Void the reference plane under AC-cap pads (100 %) and ESD pads (60 %) on the adjacent layer
rules.note: Changes plane geometry; reported, not generated, until P4.

rules.rule: CC traces >= 0.2 mm (carry VCONN current)
VBUS sized for the port current; at 5 A ~3 mm outer (0.5 oz + plating), > 5 mm inner, >= 4 vias per layer change
rules.note: Default current 3 A (Type-C default max without PD 5 A cable). See PWR-01.

rules.rule: ESD/TVS on CC, SBU, D+/D-, VBUS as close to the receptacle as possible
Sink (UFP) needs Rd = 5.1 kohm on each CC unless the controller integrates it
SBU: no numeric layout rule found; treat as low-speed signal with ESD at the connector

roles.magnetics: discrete transformer between phy and rj45 (absent for MagJack)
roles.mdi_pairs: TX+/TX-, RX+/RX- (and pairs C/D at 1G) between phy and magnetics
roles.mac_bus: RMII/RGMII nets between phy and MAC

rules.rule: MDI pairs 100 ohm differential (50 ohm single-ended)
Intra-pair mismatch <= 0.51 mm at 1G, <= 1.27 mm at 10/100; each pair on one layer to the magnetics, no stubs
PHY to magnetics < 50.8 mm
rules.note: SMSC AN18.0 gives a 25.4-76.2 mm window (minimum for ESD); TI gives < 50.8 mm. Default TI; minimum not enforced.

rules.rule: >= 0.76 mm between different pairs; same-layer copper >= 3w (5w preferred); other high-speed traces >= 7.6 mm from the front end
No copper under discrete magnetics on the component layer and the layer below (all layers for automotive), void 0.5 mm beyond the body; not required under integrated-magnetics RJ45
Chassis (earth) ground isolated from circuit ground by >= 0.51 mm on all layers; many designs use ~2 mm for 1500 Vrms hipot
rules.note: 0.508 mm read in SNLA387; the 2 mm practice value is recalled, not verified.

rules.rule: Planes stop at the middle of the magnetics; only line pairs cross from there to the RJ45; chassis plane around RJ45 overlaps nothing else
Bob Smith termination: 75 ohm per pair centre tap to a common 1000 pF / 2 kV capacitor to chassis; unused RJ45 pairs terminated the same way, close to the RJ45
Magnetics oriented with line side facing the RJ45 and PHY side facing the PHY
PHY crystal/oscillator and RBIAS resistor close to the PHY; one crystal per device; all crystal parts on the top layer
rules.note: 10 mm is TraceMaker's default (see XTAL-01).

rules.rule: RGMII: 50 ohm, TXD[3:0] and RXD[3:0] each matched within 11 ps (~1.5 mm), length < 50.8 mm (152 mm max); 2 ns clock delay from the PHY/MAC internal delay, not trace
RMII/MII: length < 152 mm, RX group and TX group matched within 1.27 mm; 50 ohm; series termination at the driver
rules.note: SNLA079 allows 50.8 mm mismatch and 68 ohm; SNLA387 asks 1.27 mm and 50 ohm. Default SNLA387.

rules.rule: Never route MDI or MAC bus over a plane split
ESD diodes on Ethernet go on the PHY side of the magnetics (exception to ESD-01 connector-side placement)
MDIO needs a 1.5 kohm pull-up at the station-management side

roles.tmds: TMDS data and clock pairs (DP main-link lanes)

rules.rule: TMDS / main-link pairs 100 ohm differential
rules.note: SLLA414 gives +/-15 %.

rules.rule: Intra-pair mismatch <= 0.127 mm
Pair-to-pair matching within 25 mm is sufficient
rules.note: Spec budget is 0.2 Tcharacter inter-pair.

rules.rule: Avoid vias (0 in TI SoC tables; <= 2 on newer SoCs); max length 102 mm
ESD next to the connector, no vias between connector and ESD pin
DisplayPort needs AC caps on main-link lanes (spec 75-200 nF); HDMI has none. DP: no copper under connector pads (pad region < 75 ohm otherwise)
100 ohm differential, tightly coupled (S < 2W), uniform W and S
Termination resistor as close to the receiver inputs as possible
rules.note: 3 mm is TraceMaker's default.

rules.rule: Intra-pair mismatch <= 0.127 mm (general high-speed default)
100 ohm differential, 50 ohm single-ended, loosely coupled (lanes also carry single-ended low-power signalling)
Intra-pair mismatch <= 0.127 mm (RPi CM5: 0.15 mm)
Clock-to-data lane mismatch <= 0.64 mm (lane skew budget 40 ps at 1.25 GHz)
<= 2 vias per line; length <= 254 mm; pair separation >= 3W

categories.name: PCI Express link (edge connector, slot, M.2)

rules.rule: 100 ohm differential (Gen1/2); 85 ohm at Gen3/4 CEM connectors; some SoCs 95 ohm +/-5 %
rules.note: Sources disagree; pick per generation (open question §11.3).

rules.rule: Intra-pair mismatch <= 0.127 mm
Inter-pair (lane-to-lane) mismatch per direction <= 14 mm
TX AC caps 220 nF (Gen3/4; spec 75-265 nF), 0402 max, symmetric, GND void under pads
rules.note: Placement within the segment disagrees: near the receiver end (DS160PR410) vs near the driver (RPi CM5).

rules.rule: Avoid vias (0 on older TI SoCs, <= 2 newer); length <= 102-140 mm; back-drill connector vias
100 ohm differential +/-15 %
Intra-pair mismatch <= 0.127 mm; length <= 89-140 mm; avoid vias
10 nF AC coupling caps on each line (spec max 12 nF)

roles.byte_lane: DQ[8n..8n+7], DM, DQS pair per byte
roles.addr_cmd: A, BA, RAS, CAS, WE, CS, CKE, ODT
roles.vtt_term: resistors to VTT at the end of the fly-by

rules.rule: 50 ohm single-ended, 100 ohm differential (CK, DQS), +/-5 %
DQ/DM within +/-0.25 mm of their DQS; DQS P/N +/-0.025 mm; whole byte on one layer
Fly-by topology; each address/command net within +/-0.51 mm of CK from controller to each DRAM; stubs < 2.0 mm; same via count per segment
VTT termination (39-42 ohm) at the last DRAM, <= 12.7 mm of trace from it
Centre-to-centre spacing >= 5W (4W only up to 1066 MT/s)
VREF: 10 nF + 100 nF at each VREF pin; trace >= 0.76 mm wide, >= 0.38 mm from other nets
40 ohm single-ended, 80 ohm differential +/-10 %; stripline over full VSS reference; no plane cuts
rules.note: Controller-specific; AM62x values. LPDDR4 per its own table.

rules.rule: DDR4: DQS-to-DQ <= 2 ps (~0.25 mm), DQS P/N <= 0.4 ps, <= 2 vias, equal via count; no cross-byte matching
DDR4: address/control to CK <= 4 ps total; CK P/N <= 0.8 ps; total <= 500 ps (~64 mm); <= 3 vias
LPDDR4: DQS P/N <= 1.5 ps, DQS-to-byte <= 150 ps, CK and address <= 450 ps; via stub <= 0.5 mm; 5W to other classes
4W to other DDR classes, 3W within a class
VREFCA 0.5 mm trace, 100 nF at each device

categories.name: SDR SDRAM / parallel memory and external buses

rules.rule: Memory close to the controller; keep the bus short (sources thin: no primary numeric value read)
rules.note: 30 mm is a TraceMaker default. Thin evidence.

rules.rule: Series source termination (22-33 ohm, 0 ohm placeholder) on clock lines next to the driver
Match bus lengths to the clock loosely (rule of thumb +/-10 mm at <= 133 MHz)
rules.note: Rule of thumb; no primary source read.

rules.rule: CLK pin to flash <= 450 ps (~70 mm stripline / 80 mm microstrip)
Each data and CS line = CLK delay +/- 60 ps (~7.6 mm)
Series resistor (0 ohm placeholder) as close as possible to the controller CLK pin; 50 ohm routing
CLK, CMD, DAT routed in parallel, all the same length, < 120 mm
rules.note: TXS0206A: keep round-trip reflection < 30 ns, load < 50 pF. tol 5 mm is TraceMaker's default for 'same length'.

rules.rule: > 1.5W spacing or GND guard between lines, especially around CLK
Series 0 ohm/22 ohm resistor on CLK close to the host
eMMC HS200/HS400: no primary numeric source read; apply SDIO-01..03 and report

roles.load_caps: caps from xin/xout nets to GND

rules.rule: Crystal as close to the IC oscillator pins as possible; trace <= 10 mm
rules.note: No vendor gives a hard number; 5-10 mm is common practice. Exception XTAL-08 (ESP32).

rules.rule: Load caps next to the crystal, between crystal and IC, short ground to the IC's VSS/oscillator ground
No vias on crystal traces
No foreign signals under the crystal/load-cap area or between crystal and IC, on any layer; solid GND on the adjacent layer
Ground guard ring around crystal, caps and traces, tied to the IC's VSS
XIN/XOUT traces short and symmetric (loose, mm scale)
Keep the crystal >= 5 mm from switching-regulator inductors/SW nodes, clocks and board edges
ESP32 family: crystal >= 2.7 mm (ESP32) / >= 2.0 mm (S3, C3) from the chip; dense GND vias around the clock trace
Check load caps: CL = C1*C2/(C1+C2) + Cstray, Cstray ~2-5 pF; C1 = C2 = 2(CL - Cstray)
100 nF decoupling at the oscillator VDD pin (see DEC-01)
Oscillator close to its load; series resistor at the source
rules.note: 20 mm is TraceMaker's default.

categories.name: MCU / FPGA / SoC / IC supply decoupling (generalises D25)

roles.pin: IC power pin on the cap's supply net (nearest, Hungarian assignment planned)
roles.bulk: caps >= 1 uF on the same rail

rules.rule: One 100 nF ceramic per power pin (or pin pair) as close as possible; < 5 mm
rules.note: Existing D25 pseudo-net reaches 1.8-3 mm; target 2 mm.

rules.rule: Smallest-value cap closest to the pin, larger caps further out
Same layer as the IC; plane -> via -> cap -> pin; no via between cap pad and IC pin
Cap-to-pin connection short and wide (length:width <= 3:1); ground via at the cap ground pad, 2 preferred
Bulk 4.7-10 uF per rail near the IC (MT-101: 10-100 uF within ~50 mm)
VDDA filtered from VDD: ferrite bead (or <= 47 ohm) + 1 uF + 10 nF at VDDA
VREF+: 100 nF + 1 uF at the pin; VCAP: 2.2 uF ceramic (ESR < 2 ohm) per pin (STM32F4/F7/H7)
FPGA/BGA: cap count per rail from the vendor table; 0402 caps under the BGA on the back side with via-in-pad
ESP32: >= 9 ground vias in the exposed pad
Hot loop: HF input cap placed first, as close to VIN/PGND as manufacturing allows (<= 2 mm), wide short copper, no vias in the loop
rules.note: 2 mm is a TraceMaker default for 'as close as allowed'.

rules.rule: Minimise SW-node copper; inductor close to the IC and rotated to keep SW short
Output loop inductor -> COUT -> PGND short; inductor, COUT, diode close together
FB trace short, taken from the output cap (Kelvin), away from inductor and SW; preferably opposite side with GND between
rules.note: 2 mm is a TraceMaker default.

rules.rule: FB divider, compensation and soft-start parts close to the IC pins; small FB node
No foreign signal traces under the inductor or SW copper on the adjacent layers
Thermal vias in the exposed pad: 0.3 mm drill at 1.0-1.2 mm pitch filling the pad (or per datasheet)
rules.note: SLVA959B instead gives 0.2 mm hole / 0.5 mm pad.

rules.rule: High-current traces: max(IPC-2221 width, 0.381 mm per A)
Grounding style per datasheet: single solid plane (ADI AN-139, modern TI) or PGND/AGND joined at the exposed pad (SLYT614)
Placement weight x8 on VIN/SW/PGND loop nets so the power stage packs tightly
rules.note: Weight is a TraceMaker choice implementing the cited placement order.

rules.rule: Hot loop is on the output side (LS switch -> rectifier -> COUT): COUT tightest, <= 2 mm
Minimise SW-node copper; inductor close to the SW pin
FB from the output cap, away from SW and inductor (as BUCK-04)
No foreign signals under inductor/SW (as BUCK-06)
Input and output caps next to their pins (< 5 mm, <= 10 mm max), ground returns direct to the LDO GND
Adjustable: divider at the FB/ADJ pin, top taken from the output cap
Thermal copper on the tab sized from PD = (VIN-VOUT)*IOUT and theta_JA; most gain in the first ~645 mm2 (1 in2) of 1 oz copper
rules.note: Needs VIN/IOUT from the user; otherwise reported only.

rules.rule: Tab/exposed pad connected solid (no thermal relief) with vias to inner/back planes

categories.name: Radio module with integrated PCB/chip antenna (ESP32, Pico W, u-blox, nRF modules)

roles.antenna_region: antenna area from the module footprint (keep-out zone in the footprint, or datasheet offset)

rules.rule: Module antenna outside the board or at the edge with the feed near the edge (ESP32: overhang strongly recommended; u-blox NINA-B3 internal antenna: corner)
No copper, vias or parts under/around the antenna region on any layer, per the module datasheet (Pico W: 14 x 9 mm cut-out; ESP32: cut the board on both sides and below if it cannot overhang)
rules.note: Hard only when the region comes from the footprint's own keep-out or a known module table; otherwise soft. Some modules (u-blox NINA-B3x2 internal antenna) want GND under the antenna: the module table decides, never a blanket rule.

rules.rule: Tall or metal parts >= 10 mm from the antenna; >= 15 mm clearance around ESP32 PCB antenna inside the housing
Ground plane extends >= 10 mm on both sides of a PCB-trace-antenna module (u-blox B3x6); dense GND vias near module ground pads

categories.name: Discrete antenna (chip antenna, PCB trace antenna, wire/whip pad)

roles.feed: net from RF pin/matching to antenna

rules.rule: Ground/copper-free clearance area around the antenna on all layers per datasheet (Johanson 2450AT18A100 ~6.5 x 13.5 mm at the board end; Ignion NN03-310 40 x 12 mm)
rules.note: Hard only with a part-table entry; unknown antennas get advisory 'keep-out unknown'.

rules.rule: Antenna at a board edge or corner
Pi (shunt-series-shunt) matching pads between RF pin and antenna
Matching parts close to the RF pin (zigzag 0201/0402)

categories.name: 50 ohm RF line (RF pin, matching, antenna or RF connector)

roles.line: net(s) from RF pin through matching to antenna/connector

rules.rule: 50 ohm, grounded coplanar waveguide preferred (2-layer 1.6 mm: ~1.0-1.2 mm wide, 0.15-0.2 mm gap; plain microstrip would be ~3 mm)
rules.note: Widths computed with Wadell GCPW formulas (er 4.4-4.6); a stackup is required to apply.

rules.rule: No vias, no 90 degree corners (135 degree or arcs), uniform width and gap, short
GND via fence along both sides at <= lambda/20 (2.4 GHz: <= 3.4 mm; practice 1-2.5 mm), 0.5-1 mm from the gap edge
rules.note: Rule of thumb, not a standard; AN928 could not be re-read.

rules.rule: Other signals >= 3w from the RF line; high-speed and switching nets kept away
u.FL: no conductors under the connector between ground pads, GND void under the signal pad on the first inner layer; SMA THT: void all layers around the centre pin
GND vias along the fence pad at <= lambda/20 (2.4 GHz: 2-3 mm typical)
No top-layer signals across the fence; parts >= 0.3-0.5 mm inside the fence
rules.note: Rule of thumb; can vendor land pattern is authoritative.

categories.name: ADC / DAC / precision analog / sensor / audio codec

rules.rule: One solid ground plane, partitioned by placement; if AGND/DGND are split, join once under the converter and never route across the split
Converter AGND and DGND pins both to the analog ground plane with short connections
Reference cap(s) directly at the VREF pin, short return to AGND
Differential inputs symmetric and coupled; anti-alias RC at the ADC pins
Guard ring around high-impedance nodes, driven at node potential or GND, mask removed
Digital, clock and switching nets >= 3W away and not parallel to analog inputs/reference
Analog front end placed away from switching regulators and their inductors (>= 10 mm)
rules.note: 10 mm is a TraceMaker default.

categories.name: High-current power path (power input, regulator in/out, motor/LED supply)

rules.rule: Width from current: IPC-2221 I = k*dT^0.44*A^0.725 (k 0.048 ext, 0.024 int; A in mil2), IPC-2152 charts when available; default dT 10 C, 1 oz
rules.note: Needs the current (user override or net-name convention). IPC-2221 internal values are very conservative vs IPC-2152.

rules.rule: Via count at layer changes >= ceil(I / I_via); I_via ~0.8 A for 0.25-0.3 mm drill, 1 oz, 10 C rise
rules.note: TI table is not monotonic per mm; treat as approximate.

rules.rule: High-current and thermal pads connect solid to zones (no spoke relief)
Via rows must not slice the return plane; keep copper webs between antipads

categories.name: Motor driver / H-bridge / MOSFET power stage / gate driver

rules.rule: Gate driver close to the MOSFETs (gate trace <= 20 mm); gate resistor at the driver or gate; driver bypass directly across its pins
rules.note: 20 mm from practice; source asks 'as close as possible'.

rules.rule: High-side gate trace routed next to its return (SH/source); >= 0.5 mm wide on >= 1 oz
Sense lines from the shunt's inner (Kelvin) pads, routed as a coupled pair to the amplifier; filter at the amplifier
Power loop (VM bypass -> HS FET -> LS FET -> GND) minimised; bypass <= 5 mm from VM pins; bulk near power entry with several vias
Thermal pad: wide top pour, via array 0.2 mm hole / 0.5 mm pad, direct connect, unmasked; 1.5-2 oz preferred
Drain sense (VDRAIN) as a single trace to the drains via a net tie; gate return to source, not the power ground path

roles.ic: IC at the far end of protected nets

rules.rule: TVS as close to the connector as the rules allow; IC much farther from the TVS than the TVS from the connector
rules.note: Ethernet exception ETH-14.

rules.rule: Routing order connector -> TVS pad -> IC, flow-through, no stub to the TVS
No via between connector and TVS (if unavoidable, reach the TVS before any branch)
No unprotected traces in the region between connector and TVS
TVS ground straight into the plane: stitching via(s) right at the ground pin (>= 2)
Straight runs or curves between connector and TVS; no 90 degree corners
Cable/mating connectors at the board edge, mating face at or slightly past the edge, facing outward
rules.note: Universal practice; no single primary source. Pin headers between boards (stacking) are excluded by footprint class.

rules.rule: Mechanical keep-out for the mating plug/cable in front of the connector (no parts taller than the board in that region)
Copper >= 0.3-0.5 mm from routed board edges (fab floor 0.2 mm; V-score 0.4 mm)
rules.note: Board edge clearance rule from the board takes precedence.

rules.rule: Copper and parts kept out to the screw head/washer diameter plus margin (M3: ~6-7 mm diameter) unless the hole is plated and grounded
rules.note: Rule of thumb; NPTH-to-copper fab minimum 0.2 mm is from JLC (V).

categories.name: Mains / high-voltage section (AC input, relay contacts, offline converter primary)

roles.barrier: parts bridging the two (transformer, opto, relay coil-contact)

rules.rule: Functional spacing between conductors from IPC-2221B Table 6-1 by peak voltage (B2 external uncoated: 0.64 mm at 31-150 V, 1.25 mm at 151-300 V, 2.5 mm at 301-500 V, +0.005 mm/V above)
rules.note: IPC-2221B prints 0.6 mm where the KiCad calculator has 0.64 mm; column letters differ between revisions. Hard only when the voltage is known (doc 15 §3.6). Not a safety spacing.

rules.rule: Safety creepage/clearance mains (250 Vrms, PD2, material group IIIb, OVC II) to SELV: basic 2.5 mm creepage / 2.0 mm clearance; reinforced 5.0 mm / 4.0 mm
rules.note: Not re-read in the standard; verify. IEC 62368-1 transient-based clearance can be lower (~1.5/3.0 mm). Medical (IEC 60601-1) is higher. The often-quoted 6.4 mm is IPC B3 / UL-era, not IEC reinforced. The report never claims compliance.

rules.rule: Slots count toward creepage only if >= 1.0 mm wide at PD2 (0.25 mm PD1, 1.5 mm PD3); effective creepage = path + width + 2 x depth around the slot
rules.note: TraceMaker does not cut slots; it reports where one would close a creepage shortfall.

rules.rule: No copper of either side under the barrier part between its primary and secondary pins, all layers

categories.name: Isolation barrier (digital isolator, optocoupler, isolated DC/DC)

rules.rule: Keep the space under the isolator free of traces, vias and pads on all layers (barrier strip between pin rows)
Side-1 to side-2 copper spacing >= the isolator's package creepage (default: body pin-row gap), never less than HV-02 when side 1 is hazardous
Optional stitching capacitance by overlapping inner planes across the barrier (isoPower EMI); keep away from the board edge
Isolator stack: >= 4 layers (signal, GND, power, signal) per TI; signal spacing >= 3h

roles.term: 120 ohm or 2 x 60 ohm across bus
roles.split_cap: 4.7 nF from split midpoint to GND

rules.rule: CANH/CANL routed as a coupled pair (~120 ohm differential), short on-board stub to the transceiver
rules.note: 120 ohm pair is a rule of thumb (cable Z0 = 120 ohm, V); at CAN rates on-board geometry matters little.

rules.rule: TVS, filter caps and CMC as close to the bus connector as possible, in line with the signal path
120 ohm termination only at the two bus ends (never on a removable node); split 2 x 60 ohm + 4.7 nF recommended for EMC
VCC/VIO bypass at the pins; >= 2 vias per supply/ground connection on bypass and protection parts

roles.bias: fail-safe pull-up on A / pull-down on B

rules.rule: A/B routed as a coupled ~120 ohm pair
TVS and termination at the connector end
120 ohm at each cable end (or 2 x 60 ohm + cap, 1 % matched); external fail-safe bias e.g. 2 x 523 ohm at 5 V; stub <= t_r*v/10
Charge-pump caps close to the IC, C1 and C2 shortest (fastest edges)
rules.note: 5 mm is a TraceMaker default; datasheet says 'short'.

rules.rule: Pull-ups between Rp_min = (VCC - 0.4 V)/3 mA and Rp_max = tr/(0.8473*Cb); Cb <= 400 pF (Std/Fast), 550 pF (Fm+); tr 1000/300/120 ns
Runs > 100 mm without planes: order SDA-VDD-VSS-SCL or SDA-VSS-SCL
Pull-ups are not placement-critical (low weight); one set per bus segment
22-33 ohm series termination at the SCK driver when the clock is more than a few cm long
rules.note: Rule of thumb; SPRAD21 recommends 22 ohm series on SPI clocks near the source.

rules.rule: Header to device <= 76 mm
TDO series termination at the device pin, <= 12.7-25.4 mm
rules.note: SPRU655I says 1 in in a table and 0.5 in in a figure note; default is the stricter.

rules.rule: Debug header reachable at the board edge (10-pin 1.27 mm / 20-pin 2.54 mm Cortex headers)
Series resistor next to the LED or its driver (thin evidence: practice only)
rules.note: No layout source; weight only. Visible LEDs belong on the user-facing side (user input).

rules.rule: High-speed lanes through an FPC follow MIPI-*/LVDS-* rules; keep ground pins and a continuous return under the connector
FPC connector at the board edge with cable exit unobstructed
rules.note: Practice (CONN-01).

rules.rule: IN, OUT and BAT caps as close as possible with short ground to the thermal pad
Thermal pad soldered with multiple vias (filled or tented); it is the main GND
Switch-mode charger sense resistor routed Kelvin (see MOT-03)

categories.name: Fuse / PTC on a power input

rules.rule: Fuse at the power-entry point before any other branch; traces sized for the fuse rating (PWR-01)
rules.note: Practice; thin primary evidence.

rules.rule: Bed-of-nails: pad >= 0.9-1.0 mm, pitch 2.54 mm preferred (1.27 mm possible), >= 3 mm from the board edge, all on one side
rules.note: Not verified this session; fixture vendors set the real limits.

rules.rule: No test points on high-speed pairs (USB2-05)
